title: Portfolio values about 100x too high

acceptableCauses.mechanism: portfolio-service switched to the v2 price endpoint (config change, 11:02 IST), which returns paise, but kept treating values as rupees: stock values x100.

keyCounterevidence: market-data-service metrics are normal and it serves the same values; the v2 endpoint documents unit=paise.
The market-data deploy at 10:40 IST is 22 minutes before the value jump at 11:02 IST.
notes: Unit mismatch, not data corruption upstream.
